    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    sunglasses_patches = image_patch.find("sunglasses")
    
    if not man_patches or not sunglasses_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    man_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in man_patches]
    sunglasses_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in sunglasses_patches]
    
    closest_sunglasses = min(sunglasses_centers, key=lambda x: abs(x - man_centers[0]))
    sunglasses_idx = sunglasses_centers.index(closest_sunglasses)
    
    return sunglasses_patches[sunglasses_idx]

def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:

    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    sunglasses_patches = image_patch.find("sunglasses")

        return image_patch
    
    man_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in man_patches]
    sunglasses_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in sunglasses_patches]

    return sunglasses_patch
